title: Mixed Event — Yesteryear Read-Aloud — Episode2 My Favorite Picture Book

meta.Event Outline: Honami volunteers to read a picture book at a neighborhood association event. To help keep the kids' attention, she asks Nene for training in voice acting.

rows.Line: A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Phew...
Why don't we take a quick break here?
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
We seem to be doing a much better job staying in rhythm during the chorus after you worked with us individually, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget.
I brought apple pies to have as snacks, so would you all like some?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That'd be lovely.
I was just craving something sweet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I also brought hot tea in my thermos.
Please have some if you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That means we get to have a little tea party.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That reminds me. Saki and the others told me that you'd be reading a picture book for an event, Honami. Is that true...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
It's an event that my neighborhood puts on regularly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you get to read that story you really love, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I'm a little worried that I won't be able to do it justice... But I'm also really excited.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wow, that's wonderful!
Can you tell me more about this story?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I've been meaning to ask that as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... I thought I put it in my bag so I could practice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, here. It's this story.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “The Star-Chasing Dog”...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is this dog on the cover the titular character?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. The story begins with him living a happy life with his owner, an ever-so-kind boy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But one day, the boy becomes desperately ill.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And the doctor notifies his family that there is no treatment available.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, in order to save the boy, the dog sets out on a journey all on his own to find a star which grants wishes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All on his own...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He must be so worried about his owner.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
And during his travels, he encounters people with wishes of their own...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As the story progresses, he decides to help them out one by one.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because he believes that's what his beloved owner would do...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what happens at the end?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He unfortunately fails to find a wish-granting star.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But all the people he helped decide to come together and repay the kindness he showed to them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And they ultimately find just the medicine the boy needed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
A happy ending.
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was a little worried there for a second.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I felt the same way when I heard this for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This dog actually didn't feel all that brave in the beginning...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But he worked up the courage to set out on a journey to save his owner, and even helped those he encountered along the way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I really love this dog's kind heart...
Which is why I found myself cheering for him the whole time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This dog sort of reminds me of you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's uncanny, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We're not talking about his appearance.
We're talking about the way you both work very hard for the sake of others.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree.
Every time you decide to help somebody, Honami, you always go above and beyond.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which probably comes from this powerful desire within you to help others out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Exactly.
And you're incredibly kind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I never thought about it that way...
But I really appreciate you two saying that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, Honami, does this book belong to you...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, my parents bought it for me after I told them just how much I loved it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I knew it.
That explains all the cute stickers on the back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that.
You made a star-studded sky.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes... When I was little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had this habit of putting stickers on all my favorite things back then... And I think I wanted to give this dog the star he deserved...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha. Now I'm a little embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't be embarrassed, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I actually really like these stickers.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because it's a great expression of just how much you love this book.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I have to think that the dog in this story can't get enough of these star stickers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... Thank you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami!
Would it be alright if I snuck over to watch you read this story at the event?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If it really does mean that much to you, then I'd love to see how you present it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course, I'll make sure to stay hidden from everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, in that case, you're more than welcome to come watch the event, as well as my practices.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you! I'm really looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope your event goes well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! I'll work hard to make sure all the children go home smiling.
